notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 timestamped regional attribute source-resignation surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, dimensional FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies queued delivery after producer resignation, ownership and membership boundaries, source-region metadata, Request Retraction behavior, reflection-before-grant ordering, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador federation resignation and timestamped regional attribute services with FederateAmbassador discovery, reflection, and grant callbacks
